name: graffish-labs
description: Small Claude Code plugins from Graffish Labs: some inspired by graffy, others that complement it.

plugins.name: graffish-core
plugins.displayName: Graffish Core (required by all Graffish plugins)
plugins.description: Installed automatically with any Graffish plugin; don't install on its own. Signs you in to Graffish once (/graffish-connect) and sends usage events to Graffish.

plugins.name: media-tool
plugins.description: For Graffish founders and collaborators only: needs a GraffishMediaTool account. Includes Graffish Core. Ask Claude about your projects' ad, organic and lead results, and save post, reply and ad drafts for a person to review.

plugins.name: support
plugins.description: Install this one. Includes Graffish Core, installed automatically. Support tickets to Graffish from Claude Code, with a pane of your own tickets.
